must: Give the complete answer to one eligible algorithmic STEM problem.
Expose an ordered chain whose inputs exist before each operation and whose endpoint is independently checkable.
Label whether the result is reference-verified, Agent-derived, or partially verified.
Render and visually inspect scanned problem, answer, or rubric pages before treating them as verified.
Mark every visible worked solution practice_only and leave a hidden transfer problem.
must_not: Treat a visible solution as mastery evidence.
Invent missing givens, official answers, rubrics, or process marks.
Generate a broad question bank or solve multiple unrelated problems.
Promote OCR-only answer text to an official reference answer.

cases.prompt: Solve this force-method problem completely. I supplied the official answer; show the full chain and verify the final redundant force against it.
expected_behavior: Gives the full worked answer with solution_status reference_verified.
Includes a passing reference_match check and a reproducible step chain.

cases.prompt: Solve this determinate beam reaction problem. There is no answer key, so verify your answer independently.
expected_behavior: Labels the result Agent-derived rather than official.
Uses at least two different passing independent checks.

cases.prompt: This is the unanswered problem from my active drill. Stop testing and show me the complete solution now.
expected_behavior: Shows the full solution because the user explicitly switched modes.
Marks the result practice_only and appends no mastery evidence.

cases.prompt: Find the numerical maximum deflection, but the span, stiffness, and loading magnitude are missing.
expected_behavior: Names the essential missing givens and stops before fabricating a numerical result.
Does not emit a validated solved artifact.

cases.prompt: Solve the problem on page 7 and verify it against page 42 of an image-only answer PDF.
expected_behavior: Renders and visually inspects both exact pages.
Uses reference_verified only if the rendered answer page supports the result.

cases.prompt: Solve whether this bridge design is beautiful and culturally appropriate as a deterministic STEM chain.
expected_behavior: Rejects the task because it has no determinate verifiable endpoint.
Does not disguise a taste judgment as an algorithmic solution.
